### Day 222: John 20:24–31
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-222-john-20-2431.html
Passage: John 20:31
Points:
- John highlights the active verb "to believe" rather than the noun "faith" to urge active, personal trust in Jesus.
- Believing in Christ must not remain a past-tense milestone confined to the day of salvation.
- Believers are challenged to move from simply believing in Christ to continually believing what He says.
- Commended faith in Scripture is marked by an ongoing walk of trust when God's work cannot be seen physically.
- Experiencing the true "life" promised in John's Gospel depends directly on this persistent act of believing.
